commonMaterial.passage:
The Quiet Lake

The lake stays still under the sky,
Its water level, like glass close by.
The sunlight shines on the waves,
And trees move slowly in the wind.

It looks so safe, it looks so nice,
A clear, shy mirror resting there.
Birds fly over, the water shines,
Showing mountains, clouds and skies.

High in the mountains, the rocks push hard,
A wall of earth, very strong.
A river once ran free and fast,
Now held back, it cannot pass.

Heavy rain falls from the sky,
Clouds get dark, the wind moves slow.
The lake is calm, but still it rises.
Its strong power waits, quiet and new.

People walk along the road,
They see the lake, they do not know.
They do not see the wall may fall,
The earth may shake, the lake may break.

A landslide-dammed lake appears so small,
But it can hurt both one and all.
Its face is still, a calm place,
Yet strong power waits hidden too.

So when you go to this quiet lake,
Remember still is not all safe.
Think about the lake, its strong power,
Its calm is a mask; the lake hides its power.

字詞：mirror 鏡子；calm 平靜的；hidden 隱藏的；poem 詩。

teachingComic.title: 先看已給的字義，再補靜止與泥土

panels.heading: ① stays still：保持靜止、平靜
panels.text: The lake stays still與Its face is still，都在描寫湖面平靜。A要補這個字義，安靜坐著、不亂動的人較符合；海浪的動態不合。
panels.alt: 少女安靜坐在校園長椅，不亂動，以日常姿勢表still的靜止義，非宗教或醫學情境。

panels.heading: ② A wall of earth：泥土形成的阻隔
panels.text: earth在這個片語中是泥土。B要畫土堆，不能因wall是牆，就直接畫磚牆。句子要整組看，earth才是本題要辨認的字。
panels.alt: 棕色園藝土堆與小芽，只表泥土材料，不畫磚牆、食物或實際堰塞湖工程。

panels.heading: ③ 原筆記已給一義，空格要補另一義
panels.text: still另一格已寫Even so / yet；earth另一格已畫地球。因此空格分別補靜止與泥土。依原文用法配圖，只有D把兩格都配對。
panels.alt: 師生讀原文與空白筆記卡，精確Even so/yet及雙義關係由HTML，不讓AI重畫錯字或原卷附圖。

points: 先核對已給的一義，避免重複或只憑題材聯想。

teachingComic.title: 崩落、堵河、蓄水，三步讀懂堰塞湖

panels.heading: ① landslide：土石從山坡崩落
panels.text: 原詩提到山中岩石與A wall of earth。C進一步說明rocks or mud從山坡落下；不是人們築起的高牆。
panels.alt: 概念俯視圖，山坡土石正往流動河道落下，藍箭頭指水流、棕箭頭指土石移動。

panels.heading: ② block a river：土石堵住河道
panels.text: 關鍵是崩落土石擋住原本流動的河水。原詩的held back與cannot pass，對應C的block a river。
panels.alt: 同一概念河段被天然土石堆橫向堵住，無人造壩體；下游河床留白，不把土石當成低地積水。

panels.heading: ③ Water collects behind it.
panels.text: it指堵河的土石阻塞物；behind it就是水被擋住、在上游一側累積成湖。B只說低地積水，漏掉堵河這個必要成因。
panels.alt: 湖水在土石阻塞物左側上游擴大，右側標示下游；示意形成過程，不給實地湖深與尺度。

fourth.answer: 答案 C：土石堵河，上游蓄水
points: landslide → block a river → water collects。
A是人造高牆，不是原詩的天然土石阻塞。
D沒交代山崩堵河；湖水變重也不是本題定義。
